message:
Classify the public customer request into a support queue. Reply with exactly ONE label: ACCESS, BILLING, DELIVERY.
Queue meanings: {"ACCESS": "account access and password recovery", "BILLING": "invoices, refunds and payment questions", "DELIVERY": "parcel delivery and shipping questions"}
Examples (use only a label present in the allowed list):
Request: Reset my login. Answer: ACCESS
Request: Correct the total on my invoice. Answer: BILLING
Request: Where is my order? Answer: DELIVERY
